body.message: Payment is simple: send over your passport copy and email, we'll fire you a payment link for the deposit, then rent is due before check-in. Once both clear, you'll get self-check-in details straight to your phone so you can head directly to the unit the moment you land. Check-in is from 3pm, so as long as payment is done before you arrive, you're good to go. What date are you looking at flying in?
